name: Afghanistan (1987–1992)
description: A horizontal tricolor of black, red and green with the state emblem — a rising sun over mountains within wheat sheaves, a cogwheel at base — in the upper hoist.
history: Flag of the Republic of Afghanistan in the Najibullah era, dropping overt communist symbolism; it fell with Kabul to the mujahideen in 1992.

features.role: rising sun, mihrab, wheat and cogwheel
